card: This pull request adds JSON script test fixtures covering script validation edge cases developed during rbitcoin's implementation. It tests witness v0 versus tapscript size limits, OP_SUCCESS evaluation precedence over script limits, lack of FindAndDelete in witness v0, tapscript signature weight budgets, and unconstrained limits on unknown tapleaf versions. The new fixtures prevent regressions and assist alternative Bitcoin implementations in verifying consensus compatibility across these edge cases. It only adds test data and has no open dependencies.
evidence: PR description: 'During rbitcoin\'s development, we created some additional script test vectors, some of which seem like they would be valuable additions to bitcoin core\'s script tests.'
problem: Bitcoin Core's shared JSON script test fixtures lack coverage for several script consensus edge cases. Alternative implementations and downstream consumers relying on these fixtures cannot use them to verify conformant handling of these boundary conditions.

risk.why: The pull request modifies only test fixtures and cannot affect node runtime or consensus validation rules.

scope_notes: The change consists entirely of additions to test vector fixtures (+196 lines across 2 files) with no modifications to consensus or validation code.
summary: Adds JSON script test vectors covering subtle script validation edge cases. These include witness v0 versus tapscript size limits, OP_SUCCESS handling prior to script limits, the bypass of FindAndDelete in witness v0, tapscript signature weight budget calculation, and unknown tapleaf version limit exemptions.
